name: Step-Up

instructions.description: Stand facing a stable step or low platform with your whole foot able to fit on top.
Place one foot fully on the step and lean slightly forward from the hips without rounding your back.
Press through the top foot to rise onto the step while keeping the working knee aligned over the toes.
Step down slowly under control and repeat before switching legs.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a step height that allows controlled ascent and descent.

variations.variationDescription: Both strengthen the lower body, but step-ups add a single-leg support and elevation demand.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Hold dumbbells once bodyweight control is solid.

commentsNotes: Do not push off aggressively with the trailing leg.
Use a handrail or wall if needed for balance.
